paragraphs.text:
The stricken wolf falls away from Norman and you turn swiftly 
toward Sylvia. But, it is too late for her. In a rage, you attack the 
beast and drive it from its kill.

A successful First Aid roll can restore 1D3 hit points to Norman or 
yourself. Go to 278.
